name: aeyhey-workspace
description: Aeyhey: spaced repetition for your saved links and your interview prep.

scripts.check:all: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm check:spdx && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.demo:local: mkdir -p data/demo && DEMO_MODE=true AUTH_MODE=none DATA_DIR=$PWD/data/demo DATABASE_URL=file:$PWD/data/demo/aeyhey.db PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3000 pnpm --filter @aeyhey/core demo:seed && DEMO_MODE=true AUTH_MODE=none DATA_DIR=$PWD/data/demo DATABASE_URL=file:$PWD/data/demo/aeyhey.db PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3000 sh -c 'trap "kill 0" EXIT; pnpm --filter @aeyhey/web worker & pnpm --filter @aeyhey/web exec next dev --port 3000'
scripts.demo:local:reset: mkdir -p data/demo && DEMO_MODE=true AUTH_MODE=none DATA_DIR=$PWD/data/demo DATABASE_URL=file:$PWD/data/demo/aeyhey.db PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3000 pnpm --filter @aeyhey/core demo:reset
scripts.local:fresh: mkdir -p data/fresh && DATA_DIR=$PWD/data/fresh DATABASE_URL=file:$PWD/data/fresh/aeyhey.db PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3000 pnpm --filter @aeyhey/web migrate && DATA_DIR=$PWD/data/fresh DATABASE_URL=file:$PWD/data/fresh/aeyhey.db PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3000 sh -c 'trap "kill 0" EXIT; pnpm --filter @aeyhey/web worker & pnpm --filter @aeyhey/web exec next dev --port 3000'
scripts.local:fresh:reset: rm -rf data/fresh && echo "data/fresh cleared. pnpm local:fresh starts a brand-new instance."
